name: How long does it take to install new exterior window trim?

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to install new exterior window trim?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of exterior window trim installation depends on the project's scope, including the number of windows, their size, and the chosen trim material. A single window might take a few hours, while an entire home can take several days. Factors like weather conditions and the need for scaffolding for multi-story homes can also influence the timeline. Our team works efficiently to minimize disruption, and we'll provide an estimated timeline during your initial consultation based on a thorough assessment of your property.
acceptedAnswer.description: Installation time varies by project scope, number of windows, and materials. A few hours for one window; several days for a whole house. Weather and access can affect timing.
